meaning:
ἀπο-κεφαλίζω
(ἀπό, κεφαλή), [in LXX: Psa.151:7 * ;]
to behead: Mat.14:10, Mrk.6:16, 28 Luk.9:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.
But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”
Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
